svg.text: Pots: 10 kΩ linear. Summing resistors: 47 kΩ. LED resistors: 330 Ω. Switches: DPDT, pole A = signal, pole B = LED (dashed line = same switch). Meter: center-zero ±100 µA.
Dots are connections. Where a wire hops over another, they are not connected.
LEDs: pole B of each input switch (same +1.5 V and −1.5 V rails as above)
